composition.currentLayout: EventSuccessCompanionRouteScreen resolves event, uid, profile, participation, plan, arrival mission, compatibility response, preference, feedback, assignments, peer profiles, and wingman state in provider waves. EventSuccessRuntime chooses one attendee moment, and EventSuccessCompanionScreen renders stage chrome plus moment cards/forms.
composition.targetLayout: The route should map provider waves into an EventSuccessCompanionScreenState and compose provider-free sections for stable chrome, stage hero, current moment, live cards, questionnaire, assignments, wingman, afterglow, and feedback. Runtime decisions stay in EventSuccessRuntime; mutations stay in EventSuccessController/EventBookingController.
